ggmtools

Shared tools for R packages that estimate multiple Gaussian graphical models, currently spikeyglass (Bayesian spike-and-slab joint graphical lasso, EM) and multiGGMr (Bayesian multiple GGMs with MRF priors, MCMC).

Both packages import ggmtools and re-export what users call. So the functions below are the same objects whichever package is attached, and one downstream script works on fits from either.

What Functions
Shared edge-table format edge_index(), as_pip_table()
Generics with methods in each package pip_table() (long table of PIPs), pcor_estimate() (one partial-correlation matrix per group)
Evaluation roc_auc() (tie-correct ROC/AUC), pr_auc() (tie-correct PR/AUPR), plot_roc(), confusion_at_threshold() (incl. FDR, MCC), topk_overlap()
Estimation error and tuning relative_frobenius(), kl_divergence(), ggm_bic()
Inference bayes_fdr() (Bayesian FDR selection), pooled_perm_pvalues() (pooled permutation null)
Matrix and edge utilities precision_to_pcor(), threshold_to_adjacency(), diff_adjacency(), upper_tri_to_matrix(), diff_edge_table()
Data brca_pi3k: TCGA BRCA PI3K-pathway expression, Normal vs Tumor (100 x 28 each)

Edge tables

Every edge table has the columns i, j, node1, node2 (one row per pair i < j, in upper.tri() order), followed by method-specific columns. pip_table() adds group and pip. Differential-edge tables (e.g. spikeyglass::diff_edges()) add est_g1, est_g2, diff and inference columns, using lower/upper for intervals.

Installation 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mljaniczek/ggmtools")
